scope: Source-only compatibility contract for CycleTrim's FetchManager.FetchablesByPrefabId.UpdatePickups replacement and Delivery Temperature Limit's temperature-partitioning transpiler. This pin is not proof of current ONI runtime compatibility.

observedContract.reason: Delivery Temperature Limit keeps candidates distinct by tag, priority, and temperature index so a nearer out-of-range pickup cannot hide a farther in-range pickup.
observedContract.cycleTrimPolicy: When the pinned Delivery Temperature Limit UpdatePickups transpiler is actually installed on the target, CycleTrim yields to the original/transpiled method. Otherwise its existing optimized path and separate FastTrack guard remain unchanged.
